reviews.body:
Thanks, the parser fix looks correct. On a457ddb the new table passes 8/8 and fails 7/8 with the parser from main; task build and unit tests for pkg/true_git, pkg/git_repo and pkg/build/stage pass.

One change needed before merge: the new spec runs git diff with the developer's global git config. With diff.noprefix=true (diff.mnemonicPrefix or color.ui=always do the same) all eight entries fail with "unexpected diff begin line", while CI stays green. Please isolate it like the other git specs in this package and mirror production quoting: patch.go passes core.quotePath=false, so the non-ASCII entry currently tests a header werf never sees.

```go
func(filename string) {
	isolateGitConfig()
	...
	cmd := exec.Command("git", "-c", "core.quotePath=false", "diff", "--no-index", "--", path, "/dev/null")
```

Optional: also assert the rewritten header written to out, so the strconv.Quote branch is covered. Removing that branch currently keeps the table green.

comments.body:
Applied the two requested changes: the deletion-path table now calls isolateGitConfig() and invokes Git with -c core.quotePath=false, matching production patch generation. The focused table passes 8/8 on this revision; with the parser from main, 6 of 8 fail.


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
